title: unify terraform private state layout: gpu node pools, iam, networking migration
author: Miguel Torres
description:
Motivation: Private deployments have diverged across modules (gpu node pools, IAM, networking) and different providers (GCP/AWS) which complicates upgrades, cross-repo automation, and state management for upgrades/rollbacks. This PR unifies the state layout and provides a migration path for existing customers with minimal downtime.

What this PR does: consolidated module state layout under `state/namespace/{env}/{component}` semantics, adds a migration helper script and documentation, introduces a feature flag `legacy_state_layout` to opt-in for staggered migration, updates examples and terratest suites, and normalizes IAM role naming to avoid drift between providers.

Checklist:
- [x] Refactor modules to the unified state layout
- [x] Add migration scripts and step-by-step README
- [x] Add `legacy_state_layout` toggle for rolling migration
- [x] Update examples and quickstarts
- [x] Add terratest/integration tests for migration path
- [x] Run staged migration in staging and private-integration clusters

Migration notes: The migration script `scripts/migrate_state_layout.sh` performs a dry-run by default and supports `--apply` to perform a real move. States are first copied and validated in a temporary backend namespace. Rollback steps are documented in `state/migrations/README.md`. For high-traffic clusters we recommend running the migration during a maintenance window and enabling `legacy_state_layout = true` for one deploy cycle to ensure zero-downtime fallbacks.

Linear/JIRA: ENG-2042 (state unification), ENG-2107 (private upgrade tooling). Related support ticket SUP-4132 (customer migration request).

Impact: This is a migration-focused change that touches state backends and resource names. All changes are behind opt-in flags and include automated verification to reduce risk. Expect infra teams to coordinate when applying to production.

Release notes: Unified Terraform state layout for Private deployments. Added migration script and docs. Introduced `legacy_state_layout` flag for staged rollouts. Normalized IAM role naming to prevent cross-provider drift.
